#Aletheia #UKNews

The government claims it is actively looking for ways to support pubs and fans by considering a late relaxation of licensing hours for the late-night World Cup match.

Following pressure from the hospitality sector, the UK government is reportedly reconsidering its refusal to grant a blanket licensing extension for England's 1am World Cup match.

The Unavoidable Truth: Bureaucratic deadlines require proactive planning, not last-minute political interventions.

The Unavoidable Lie: The government is doing everything it can to help pubs show the match.
